analogy.rationale: Guanylyl cyclase activators raise cGMP, but the annotated targets include HIF1A and the soluble guanylyl cyclase subunits are poorly expressed in most of these lines, so the transcriptional response should be weak; the closest analogs are other cGMP/cAMP-elevating classes such as adenylyl cyclase activators and phosphodiesterase inhibitors.
